Docs.summary: Runtime registry that maps live page/view instances to their child components by stable node ID. Used by XSG-generated InitializeComponent() and UpdateComponent() methods to find live objects during incremental XAML Hot Reload without re-inflation.

remarks.para: Registration is keyed on the page instance (not type), so multiple concurrent instances of the same page type each have their own component map. Components are held via so they do not prevent GC of abandoned instances.
This class is trim-safe: it stores references with no reflection on user types.

Docs.remarks: This type is public for source-generator access only. It is not intended to be used directly.

Docs.summary: Removes all component registrations whose node ID starts with the given prefix (the node itself and all descendants whose ID matches the pattern prefix/...). Provided as a utility for callers that use hierarchical slash-separated node IDs.
Docs.remarks: The current XAML source generator assigns flat integer IDs (e.g. "0", "1") and emits one Unregister call per removed descendant (descendants are pre-collected by the diff). This method is therefore not used by the generator today; it remains for callers that adopt a hierarchical ID scheme.
